import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

const SELLER = 1539401;
const SKU = 101;

describe('экран', () => {
  it('показывает товар', () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem('memory', JSON.stringify({ seller: String(SELLER), sku: SKU, from: 'day' }));
    const option = (value: string, title: string) => ({ value, title, offerId: null, imageUrl: null });
    render(<Screen options={[option(String(SKU), 'Тонер')]} cabinets={[{ seller: Number(SELLER) }]} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('cell')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('показывает товар', () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem('memory', JSON.stringify({ seller: String(SELLER), sku: SKU, from: 'day' }));
    const option = (value: string, title: string) => ({ value, title, offerId: null, imageUrl: null });
    render(<Screen options={[option(String(SKU), 'Тонер')]} cabinets={[{ seller: Number(SELLER) }]} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('cell')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('запоминает выбор', () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem('memory', JSON.stringify({ seller: String(SELLER), sku: SKU, from: 'day' }));
    const option = (value: string, title: string) => ({ value, title, offerId: null, imageUrl: null });
    expect(window.localStorage.getItem('memory')).toBe(JSON.stringify({ seller: String(SELLER), sku: SKU, from: 'day' }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('cell')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('читает адрес', () => {
    const read = (input: string) => String(input);
    const parse = (input: string) => String(input);
    expect(read('a') + parse('b')).toBe('ab');
  });
});
